offer.line: Well, I'd know that you'd offer
stanza: Well, I'd know that you'd offer
Would reveal it, though it's soft and flat
Won't repeat it, cull and coffer's that
For the soffit, hang this homeward
Pry it open with your love
Sending lost and alone standing offers
Ring the bells that still can ring
Forget your perfect offering
There is a crack, a crack in everything
That's how the light gets in
Heaven, make me an offer
Lord, there's nothing for me left out here
Heaven, if you come over
Oh, I know how to make us disappear

offer.line: Don't impress me, what can I offer?
stanza: 'Cause great men of science and literature
Don't impress me, what can I offer?
Because I am a chisel in Your hand
Screaming at marble from a microphone stand

offer.line: When pain is all that they offer
stanza: When pain is all that they offer
Like the kiss from the lips of a monster
You know the famine so well, but never met the feast
When home is the belly of the beast

offer.line: With grace in all she offers
stanza: Some days, like rain on the doorstep, she'll cover me
With grace in all she offers
Sometimes I'd like just to ask her what honest words
She can't afford to say, like

offer.line: You wanted something that we offer
stanza: We told you this was melodrama
You wanted something that we offer
We told you this was melodrama
You wanted something that we offer
We told you this was melodrama
You wanted something that we offer
We told you this was melodrama
You wanted something that we offer
I turn to you to and ask
For something we can offer
Three lines of traffic pass
We pull away so fast
All my words get swallowed
Heavenly father
Is all that he offers
A safety in the end
